title: A table can switch between wrapped cells and one line per row
body:
A code block wider than the box has a `wrap pan` toggle in its header row, as in `┌ rust   wrap pan   ⧉` (coax-06ff60). coax keeps the choice per block in `App::wraps`. A table has no header row, so it has nowhere to show the toggle.

After coax-7d9a45, a table wraps a long cell inside a capped column. The pan form, with each row on one line at its natural width, is easier for comparing rows. A toggle would let a person switch one table between the two.

## Open

- Where the toggle sits on a table.
- When a table shows it. A table that fits the box at its natural width has nothing to switch.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/85c47808
notes.text: coax-698acc gives every table a header row, `┌ table   rules`, drawn by coax above cmr's rows. The wrap and pan words can go in that row next to `rules`.
